script: If you run a club, pull up your last tryout announcement. Could a family tell what the season would cost, including uniforms and travel? Could they ask about financial aid privately? If their ride fell through, was there another time a coach would watch them play? Picture that same girl getting one more text: "Saturday evaluation, ten a.m. Same coaches. Same chance to make the team." On Saturday, she steps onto the field. The coach rolls her a ball. For the first time all week, the next move is hers. Before you post your next tryout, publish the cost, offer a second evaluation, and tell families how to get there.
